textos.Acciones africanas cotizadas (por ejempl: Tokenised listed African shares (for example, from the Nairobi Securities Exchange), bonds and local stablecoins, with loans and token-based IPOs.
textos.Acciones y bonos tokenizados. Sus términ: Tokenised shares and bonds. Its terms designate a Liechtenstein company as counterparty and choose German law.
textos.Acciones y ETF de EE. UU. tokenizados qu: Tokenised US shares and ETFs that trade 24 hours a day on Solana and can be redeemed for the share on Backpack Exchange.
Tokenised US shares and ETFs that trade 24 hours a day on X Layer, the OKX network.
textos.Autora del estándar ERC-3643, para token: Author of the ERC-3643 standard, for tokens with built-in compliance rules.
textos.Autorizada y supervisada por la FCA brit: Authorised and supervised by the UK FCA under number 838656, as an exchange, broker and custodian, and entered on its cryptoasset register. It has permission to operate a multilateral trading facility, not just to act as an intermediary.
textos.Banco internacional; en Hong Kong tokeni: International bank; in Hong Kong it tokenises and holds in custody, with its own services, a class of an HSBC Asset Management fund.
textos.Bolsa de valores española nativa en bloc: Spanish blockchain-native stock exchange, part of the Bit2Me group, under the European DLT Pilot Regime for market infrastructures.
textos.Cada inmueble está registrado en el Depa: Each property is registered with the Dubai Land Department (DLD), which issues the ownership certificate for the tokens, according to its help pages.
textos.Cada token representa una onza concreta: Each token represents a specific ounce of gold allocated in London vaults, identifiable by bar number.
textos.Cada token se apoya en un acuerdo societ: Each token is backed by a corporate agreement of the issuer, stored on IPFS, which identifies the property by its land registry details and binds the issuer to the token holders. It is not an entry in the land registry.
textos.CaliberCos Inc., gestora inmobiliaria es: CaliberCos Inc., a US real estate asset manager, has tokenised three more offerings: two hotel developments and a fund.
textos.Capa de cumplimiento normativo para emis: Regulatory compliance layer for token issuers.
textos.Captaciones de empresas y promociones in: Fundraisings by Brazilian companies and real estate developments (special purpose companies) in the form of tokenised assets, in reais.
textos.Casa de valores japonesa; es la entidad: Japanese securities firm; it is the entity that places the MUFG Realty Token, with Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking as trustee.
textos.Certificados tokenizados que siguen el v: Tokenised certificates that track the value of shares in companies that are not yet listed (pre-IPO), and stablecoin strategies.
textos.Clases tokenizadas de fondos de Amundi:: Tokenised classes of Amundi funds: a euro money market fund and, since 05/11/2026, its STOXX Europe 600 index fund.
textos.Colb Asset SA, de Ginebra, dice ser inte: Colb Asset SA, of Geneva, says it is a financial intermediary registered under Swiss law, distributes securities in accordance with FinSA and is a member of ARIF, a self-regulatory organisation approved by FINMA.
textos.Crédito privado para instituciones y pro: Private credit for institutions and on-chain yield products (syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT).
textos.Cromos y coleccionables físicos (cartas: Tokenised trading cards and physical collectibles (Pokémon cards, sports cards).
textos.Custodia y emisión de valores digitales: Digital securities custody and issuance for banking, meeting the banking sector's audit requirements.
textos.Deuda pública tokenizada para la tesorer: Tokenised government debt for companies' treasury and «float».
textos.DigiFT Tech (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. dice t: DigiFT Tech (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. says it holds a capital markets services licence from the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS).
textos.Emisión e inversión en deuda privada tok: Issuance of and investment in tokenised private debt under Swiss DLT securities law; its main product, oTFY, is trade finance debt from 100,000 dollars.
textos.Emisión y custodia de activos tokenizado: Issuance and custody of tokenised assets in El Salvador; it does not offer the issuances to the public through its website.
textos.Emisiones tokenizadas en el sudeste asiá: Tokenised issuances in Southeast Asia (infrastructure, private credit) for accredited investors only.
textos.Emisor de bonos soberanos tokenizados (C: Issuer of tokenised sovereign bonds (Mexican CETES, Brazilian Tesouros, US Treasury bills, Eurobonds and gilts) with weekly proof of reserves and regulated custodians, according to its website.
textos.Emite acciones y ETF de EE. UU. tokeniza: Issues tokenised US shares and ETFs on Solana: each token is a claim against a special purpose vehicle that holds the share, and can be redeemed 1 to 1 on Backpack Exchange.
textos.Emite bajo un folleto base aprobado por: Issues under a base prospectus approved by the Liechtenstein FMA on 17/07/2026 and notified to the CNMV. Approval of the prospectus is not a licence: according to the prospectus itself, the issuer is not regulated by the FMA.
textos.Empresa chilena de infraestructura de to: Chilean white-label tokenisation infrastructure company; it says it is in the process of obtaining authorisation from the CMF under the Fintec Law 21.521.
textos.Empresa con sede en Buenos Aires y Monte: Company based in Buenos Aires and Montevideo that publishes tokenised properties recorded on Polygon. Its website does not declare a securities licence.
textos.Empresa industrial alemana que se financ: German industrial company that raises financing through a tokenised bond on Polygon, subscribed only on its own platform.
textos.En el EEE, USDY exige ser cliente profes: In the EEA, USDY requires being a professional client or qualified investor. Issuer, product and jurisdiction are reviewed separately: there is no record of a single licence for the whole brand.
textos.En Hong Kong ofrece, desde su app, un fo: In Hong Kong it offers, from its app, a dollar money market fund with tokenised units for individuals and institutions.
textos.En Hong Kong, su moneda estable HSBC Red: In Hong Kong, its stablecoin HSBC RedCoin gives access from the bank's app to a tokenised class of its Hong Kong dollar money market fund.
textos.Es un mercado de NFT de coleccionables f: It is an NFT marketplace for physical collectibles, not a licensed securities market. On 20/11/2026 we were unable to verify custody or redemption on its website.
textos.Es un protocolo, no el emisor: cada fond: It is a protocol, not the issuer: each fund has its own vehicle, jurisdiction and offering document. Its terms say the products may not be regulated.
textos.Estating S.A., de Luxemburgo, estructura: Estating S.A., of Luxembourg, structures each real estate investment as a security with an ISIN through its own Luxembourg securitisation vehicle.
textos.Estructura de fondo con calificación cre: Fund structure with an agency credit rating and reserves in Treasury bills held by a third-party custodian.
textos.Exposición a deuda pública de EE. UU. y,: Exposure to US government debt and, since 2026, to tokenised Franklin Templeton ETFs.
textos.Figure Securities, Inc. es bróker-dealer: Figure Securities, Inc. is a broker-dealer registered with the SEC (FINRA, CRD 307093) and operates an ATS. That registration does not cover Figure's other companies.
textos.Filial de tokenización de HashKey Holdin: Tokenisation subsidiary of HashKey Holdings, a Hong Kong digital asset group listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange (stock code 3887).
textos.Financiación de carteras de préstamos y: Financing of loan and invoice portfolios with off-chain collateral.
textos.Finexity AG cotiza en Xetra (ISIN DE000A: Finexity AG is listed on Xetra (ISIN DE000A40ET88). Its 2026/2030 bond has a KID per series, with BaFin as the competent authority for that document.
textos.Fireblocks Trust Company, LLC figura en: Fireblocks Trust Company, LLC is listed by the NYDFS as a limited purpose trust company. That licence belongs to that company, not to all of its software.
textos.Fondo inmobiliario (REIT) de pisos en ci: Real estate investment trust (REIT) of apartments in US cities whose shares can be held on-chain as GromaCoin.
textos.Fondo monetario de deuda pública con el: Government money market fund whose shareholder register has been kept on-chain since 2021.
US government money market fund with an on-chain share register, which seeks to maintain 1 dollar per share.
US money market fund (FOBXX). For US residents only: its prospectus of 01/08/2026 says it is not registered and may not be offered in any EU or EEA country.
textos.Fondo monetario estadounidense (MCGXX) q: US money market fund (MCGXX) that publishes its prospectus; it is advised by M3Sixty Capital, which says it is registered with the SEC (we have not verified this).
textos.Fondo privado estadounidense (USTB, gest: US private fund (USTB, managed by Invesco Advisers), with an independent auditor (PwC) and custodian (BNY); it is not registered as an investment company. Superstate Services is a transfer agent registered with the SEC.
textos.Fondos de capital riesgo y private equit: Fractionalised venture capital and private equity funds for accredited investors.
textos.Fondos de deuda pública con las particip: Government debt funds with units recorded directly on-chain.
textos.Fondos en euros y dólares para la tesore: Euro and dollar funds for the treasury of companies and individuals, with daily redemption.
textos.Fondos monetarios de la SICAV francesa S: Money market funds of the French SICAV Spiko SICAV, managed by Twenty First Capital. Not all of them appeared on 20/11/2026 in the AMF's public database: check fund by fund.
textos.Gestora estadounidense; en Hong Kong ofr: US asset manager; in Hong Kong it offers a Hong Kong dollar money market fund with tokenised and conventional units.
textos.Gestora europea que tokeniza clases de s: European asset manager that tokenises classes of its own funds with CACEIS (Crédit Agricole group) as tokenisation agent; the fund also remains available through its usual channels.
textos.Groma NAV REIT, Inc. publica su memorand: Groma NAV REIT, Inc. publishes its private placement memorandum and its SEC filings (Form D and Regulation Crowdfunding); the official share register is kept by Colonial Stock Transfer.
textos.Grupo alemán que emite, registra y distr: German group that issues, registers and distributes tokenised securities; it is now placing its own 2026/2030 bond, also as a crypto security (German eWpG law).
textos.Grupo con sociedades autorizadas según s: Group with companies authorised, according to its website, by the UK FCA (FRN 1045023), in Ireland under MiFID and by VARA in Dubai (licence VL/25/05/002).
textos.Hator S.A.S. de C.V. dice estar regulada: Hator S.A.S. de C.V. says it is regulated in El Salvador by the National Commission of Digital Assets (CNAD) and the Superintendency of the Financial System.
textos.HWK 1365 SE, de Königsbronn (Alemania),: HWK 1365 SE, of Königsbronn (Germany), is the holding company of the Hüttenwerke Königsbronn foundry. It issues its tokenised bond itself; it is not a financial institution.
textos.Infraestructura de tokenización, emisión: Infrastructure for tokenising, issuing, distributing and trading assets of Latin American companies.
textos.Infraestructura para estructurar, emitir: Infrastructure to structure, issue and manage tokenised products (real estate, private markets) for asset managers and distributors.
textos.Inmuebles comerciales tokenizados en GIF: Tokenised commercial properties in GIFT City (India), with tokens from 1,000 dollars and resale between investors.
textos.Inmuebles de alquiler en África (hoteles: Rental properties in Africa (boutique hotels, villas in Zanzibar) tokenised through special purpose vehicles.
textos.Inmuebles de calidad institucional para: Institutional-grade real estate for wealth managers and regulated advisers; product partner of Reental since October 2026.
textos.Inmuebles tokenizados (sobre todo vivien: Tokenised properties (mainly rental homes in Miami) from 50 dollars, with monthly rental income in dollars and resale on the platform itself.
textos.INX Securities, LLC es bróker-dealer reg: INX Securities, LLC is a broker-dealer registered with the SEC, a member of FINRA, and operates an alternative trading system (ATS). Since 11/2025 it has belonged to OpenDeal, Inc. (Republic), which according to FINRA is not a listed company.
textos.La opera Mitsui & Co. Digital Asset Mana: It is operated by Mitsui & Co. Digital Asset Management, which its website lists as a registered financial intermediary in Japan (Kanto Local Finance Bureau, No. 3277).
textos.Letras del Tesoro de EE. UU. envueltas e: US Treasury bills wrapped in a subscription and redemption token, for professional clients.
textos.Licencia de mercado reconocido del MAS d: Recognised market licence from the MAS in Singapore. Shareholders of its parent company: the SGX exchange, Heliconia, UOB and others.
textos.Liquidación, registro y emisión de activ: Settlement, registration and issuance of tokenised assets for European institutions, with central bank money or on-chain cash.
textos.Lo emite Paxos Trust Company, N.A., banc: It is issued by Paxos Trust Company, N.A., a US national trust bank supervised by the OCC, with monthly attestations of the gold.
textos.Los xStocks los emite una sociedad de Je: xStocks are issued by a Jersey company (Backed Assets (JE) Limited), with the asset held 1:1 by regulated custodians and public proof of reserves.
textos.Luxivana Pty Ltd es representante autori: Luxivana Pty Ltd is an authorised representative (CAR 1321612) of Trend Capital Group, which holds an Australian financial services licence (AFSL 255475), according to its website.
textos.Marca de MIO3, S.A. de C.V., que dice es: Brand of MIO3, S.A. de C.V., which says it is authorised in El Salvador as a digital asset service provider (PSAD-0016), under the supervision of the CNAD.
textos.Marca de Pulpo Fintech, S.A. de C.V., pr: Brand of Pulpo Fintech, S.A. de C.V., a digital asset service provider registered with El Salvador's CNAD under No. PSAD-0023, according to its website.
textos.Marca sus ofertas con la Resolución CVM: Labels its offerings with CVM Resolution 88, the Brazilian CVM's regime for crowdfunding.
textos.Mercado australiano de participaciones t: Australian market for tokenised fund units; each product it lists is originated by an asset manager holding an AFSL licence, according to its website.
textos.Mercado de capitales nativo en blockchai: Blockchain-native capital market for private credit and tokenised assets, with home equity lines of credit (HELOC) on its own chain.
textos.Mercado de Hong Kong con productos token: Hong Kong market with tokenised products (funds, bonds and certificates); its USTNT product on US Treasury bonds is for professional investors only.
textos.Mercado de valores tokenizados de OKX e: Tokenised securities market from OKX and ICE launched on 23/11/2026, only for clients of OKX Inc. in the US who meet the requirements.
textos.Mercado regulado de fondos y productos t: Regulated market for on-chain tokenised funds and products for accredited and institutional investors in Asia.
textos.Mercado regulado de valores digitales en: Regulated digital securities market in London that brings together issuance, trading and custody under the same licence. Beware of clones: the FCA has published warnings about websites impersonating it, and the valid domain is archax.com.
textos.Mercado secundario de Singapur para valo: Singapore secondary market for tokenised securities: it lists 22 (money market and gold funds, referenced US shares and private holdings in Malaysia), which are bought and sold between investors.
textos.Mercado secundario en EE. UU. para valor: US secondary market for securities issued on-chain.
textos.Mercado sudafricano de activos financier: South African market for tokenised financial assets: preference shares, bonds and gold, with issuance, trading and settlement on the same platform.
textos.Mercados privados troceados desde import: Fractionalised private markets from small amounts: unlisted companies, funds, film, sport and art. Important: its Mirror Tokens are not shares in the company they mirror, but promissory notes from Republic itself that pay out only if there is an IPO or an acquisition.
textos.Mesh Trade South Africa (Pty) Ltd dice s: Mesh Trade South Africa (Pty) Ltd says it is an authorised financial services provider in South Africa (FSP 53710).
textos.Oaksvale Ventures Limited está inscrita: Oaksvale Ventures Limited is incorporated as a company in Nigeria (RC 7194242) and in Tanzania. Its website does not declare a securities licence.
textos.Obligate AG, de Zúrich, dice ser interme: Obligate AG, of Zurich, says it is a financial intermediary under the Swiss anti-money laundering law and a member of VQF, a self-regulatory organisation supervised by FINMA.
textos.Opera con entidades registradas y superv: Operates through entities registered and supervised in the US: OpenDeal Portal LLC as a funding portal with the SEC and FINRA since 2016, and OpenDeal Broker LLC as a broker-dealer member of FINRA and SIPC.
textos.Participaciones de fondos y planes de in: Units in Australian funds and investment schemes represented by tokens, for verified investors.
textos.Participaciones tokenizadas de ofertas i: Tokenised interests in Caliber's real estate offerings in the US (hotels and funds).
textos.Pisos y locales tokenizados en Nigeria (: Tokenised apartments and commercial premises in Nigeria (for example, in Abuja) for investors in the country and in the diaspora.
textos.Plataforma austriaca de distribución de: Austrian platform for distributing tokenised securities that says it is regulated under MiFID II and operates in 30 EEA countries.
textos.Plataforma brasileña de inversión colect: Brazilian collective investment platform that says it operates under the crowdfunding rule of the CVM, Brazil's securities regulator.
textos.Plataforma brasileña de renta fija token: Brazilian tokenised fixed-income platform: corporate receivables certificates (certificados de recebíveis, CR), in reais.
textos.Plataforma de activos digitales de Hong: Hong Kong digital asset platform that lists, distributes and holds in custody the tokenised units of Taikang's money market fund, which according to OSL is authorised by the SFC.
textos.Plataforma de activos virtuales de Hong: Hong Kong virtual asset platform that says it has been approved by the SFC since December 2024 (under the provisional licence regime); we have not verified this.
textos.Plataforma de Dubái para tokenizar e inv: Dubai platform for tokenising and investing in real-world assets; it shows each investor what they can buy according to their profile.
textos.Plataforma de GIFT City (India) que dice: GIFT City (India) platform that says it operates in the IFSCA's regulatory sandbox; its first tokenised fund is ORYX.
textos.Plataforma de tokenización de Indonesia: Indonesian tokenisation platform that offers in its app tokenised funds (money market and private credit) that are subscribed with USDT.
textos.Plataforma de tokenización de Singapur n: Singapore tokenisation platform born in SC Ventures, Standard Chartered's incubator. It provides the technology; the management and compliance of each fund are the responsibility of its manager.
textos.Plataforma de tokenización, administraci: Platform for tokenising, administering and trading securities; each function is carried out by a different company in the group.
textos.Plataforma de valores digitales con nego: Digital securities platform with secondary trading.
textos.Plataforma del grupo Boerse Stuttgart pa: Boerse Stuttgart group platform for settling tokenised assets, open to banks, brokers and markets across Europe.
textos.Plataforma en marca blanca para que inmo: White-label platform for real estate companies, funds and issuers to tokenise their assets in Chile.
textos.Plataforma europea de financiación parti: European crowdfunding platform, in German; among other things, it places corporate bonds registered as crypto securities.
textos.Plataforma japonesa de valores digitales: Japanese digital securities platform of the Mitsui group: real estate and, now, the first digital bond from Mitsui & Co. for individual investors.
textos.Plataforma salvadoreña que coloca emisio: Salvadoran platform that places tokenised issuances registered with the CNAD (corporate debt, real estate projects) and tokenised US shares and ETFs.
textos.Protocolo descentralizado: su token wYLD: Decentralised protocol: its wYLDS token is backed by YLDS, which its website describes as a registered fixed-income security of Figure Certificate Company. Hastra does not declare a licence of its own.
textos.Proveedor danés de software de tokenizac: Danish provider of white-label tokenisation software for asset managers, real estate companies and businesses, with published enterprise pricing.
textos.Proveedor suizo de custodia para bancos: Swiss custody provider for regulated banks, with verifiable deployments at European institutions.
textos.Proyectos inmobiliarios en España y Lati: Real estate projects in Spain and Latin America from €100.
textos.Reaseguro tokenizado: el valor de ONyc s: Tokenised reinsurance: the value of ONyc tracks the premiums collected minus the claims of a segregated account in Bermuda.
textos.Réplicas tokenizadas de acciones y bonos: Tokenised replicas of listed shares and bonds.
textos.Se presenta como mercado regulado y en c: Presents itself as a regulated, on-chain market for tokenised African securities (listed shares, sovereign bonds and local stablecoins).
textos.Según Bit2Me, la CNMV la autorizó como a: According to Bit2Me, the CNMV authorised it as a broker (agencia de valores) in November 2025 and granted it a DLT Pilot Regime trading system licence in October 2026.
textos.Según su web, 1X Exchange Pte. Ltd. es u: According to its website, 1X Exchange Pte. Ltd. is a recognised market (Recognised Market Operator) under the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS); we have not verified this in the MAS register.
textos.Según su web, CONDA Capital GmbH es un p: According to its website, CONDA Capital GmbH is a crowdfunding service provider authorised under European Regulation (EU) 2020/1503 (we have not verified this); the website itself warns that the authorisation is not a state guarantee.
textos.Según su web, es una empresa norteameric: According to its website, it is a North American company that offers investments from the US and Spain, and its activity in Spain is not subject to prior authorisation or registration by the CNMV.
textos.Según su web, PT Desentra Teknologi Indo: According to its website, PT Desentra Teknologi Indonesia takes part in the OJK's financial innovation sandbox (letter S-445/IK.01/2025); a sandbox is not a licence and we have not verified this with the OJK.
textos.Según sus términos, la contraparte es Sw: According to its terms, the counterparty is Swarm Capital GmbH (Vaduz, Liechtenstein). There is no record of a licence: BaFin does not have it in its database (20/11/2026) and its legal notice does not name a supervisor.
textos.Según sus términos, Lofty no está regist: According to its terms, Lofty is not registered with the SEC or any other body, and according to its website it is not a registered broker-dealer. Its marketplace is not a registered offering.
textos.Shard Developers Ltd, de Abuja (Nigeria): Shard Developers Ltd, of Abuja (Nigeria), publishes tokenised properties with documentation and restricts transfers to verified investors. Its website does not declare a securities licence.
textos.Software de custodia y emisión de activo: Digital asset custody and issuance software for businesses and institutions.
textos.Software para emitir, gestionar y negoci: Software to issue, manage and trade tokenised assets (real estate, funds, company shares).
textos.Su crédito institucional es para inverso: Its institutional credit is for accredited investors who complete onboarding (KYC/AML). Maple says that syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT are open on-chain outside the US, but the terms of that interface also exclude other jurisdictions and say that the operator is not registered with any regulator.
textos.Su filial Securitize Markets, LLC es bró: Its subsidiary Securitize Markets, LLC is a broker-dealer registered with the SEC, a member of FINRA, and operates an alternative trading system (ATS). The group's other functions sit in other subsidiaries.
textos.Su token ONyc representa una parte de un: Its ONyc token represents a share of a Bermuda segregated account that backs reinsurance contracts. The public interface warns that the token bought through it does not give rights against On Re SAC Ltd.
textos.Su web de Hong Kong, de BlackRock Asset: Its Hong Kong website, from BlackRock Asset Management North Asia (SFC licence), says that the funds it presents are authorised by the SFC for sale to the public in Hong Kong.
textos.Sus dos sociedades de Singapur dicen ten: Its two Singapore companies say they hold MAS licences: capital markets services (CMS100573) and recognised market operator.
textos.Tecnología para emitir y distribuir fond: Technology to issue and distribute tokenised funds and bonds; among others, FundBridge Capital's US Treasury bill fund «ULTRA», sub-managed by Wellington.
textos.Tecnología para que una inmobiliaria tok: Technology for a real estate company to tokenise its own assets.
textos.Tokens con rendimiento de préstamos: sob: Tokens earning yield from loans: on Figure's YLDS security and, if locked, on home equity lines of credit, car loans or small business loans.
textos.Tokens respaldados 1:1 por activos de un: Tokens backed 1:1 by assets of a regulated investment fund in Australia, from 25,000 dollars.
textos.Tokinvest DMCC tiene licencia activa de: Tokinvest DMCC holds an active VARA (Dubai) licence, VL/2024/12/004, for brokerage and issuance of virtual assets, with permission to serve retail clients.
textos.tZERO Securities, LLC es bróker-dealer r: tZERO Securities, LLC is a broker-dealer registered with FINRA and operates an alternative trading system (ATS). The group's other functions sit in other companies.
textos.Valores tokenizados de la serie «hToken»: Tokenised securities in the «hToken» series: the first, linked to units in a HashKey fund, is for professional investors only.
textos.Valores tokenizados para inversores del: Tokenised securities for EEA investors: tokenised US shares and ETFs (xStocks, Ondo) and inventory and invoice financing.
textos.Vende en Japón valores inmobiliarios tok: Sells tokenised real estate securities (security tokens) in Japan from 100,000 yen, with online applications for its clients.
textos.Vivienda unifamiliar troceada desde 50 $: Fractionalised single-family homes from $50, with daily distribution of rental income and investor voting on each property.
textos.Viviendas de Dubái tokenizadas desde 1.0: Tokenised Dubai homes from 1,000 dirhams (AED), with resale on its own marketplace.
